title: Tunisian Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish originating from Tunisia, featuring chicken cooked in a rich blend of spices and herbs.
instructions: 1. Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
3. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
4. In the same skillet, add the onions and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Add the harissa, honey, and lemon juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
6. Add the chicken back to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
7. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
8. Season with tunisian spices and serve hot.
